relationship.original_equation: Periodic cost = discount fraction / (1 - discount fraction)
relationship.translation_notes: The input and output are base-one fractions. The denominator is the discounted invoice amount, not the gross invoice amount.

variables.definition: Forgone discount divided by the discounted early payment amount
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Early payment is the full invoice less the stated discount; late payment is the full invoice.

limitations: This is the cost for the additional credit interval, not an annualized rate.
A 100% discount leaves no positive early payment base and is excluded.

models.summary: The example subtracts ending accumulated depreciation from beginning accumulated depreciation plus current depreciation.

relationship.original_equation: Accumulated depreciation removed = beginning accumulated depreciation + period depreciation - ending accumulated depreciation
relationship.locator: Preparing cash flow from investing activities, accumulated depreciation on equipment sold
